summary: M1-M6 implemented with correct layering, exact §6.1 weights, idempotent identity_key upsert, authority-precedence conflict resolution preserving losers, cancellation handling, and a green offline end-to-end flow (make check + e2e/web all pass); only two minor cosmetic findings.

findings.detail: FEAT-001 findings describe save_event as 'UPSERT by event.dedup_key', but the shipped SqliteRepository upserts by identity_key (date + title tokens). The implementation is correct and is what makes AC-11 time/venue-change-in-place work; the recorded note is stale and should be updated to say identity_key so it does not mislead.

Event-level food confirmation is resolved by the dedicated _resolve_food path (correct for E-5), and _apply_field skips food_confirmed, so its FieldProvenance row is always 'missing' even when sources agree. Cosmetic inconsistency — the decision is captured in verification_state and food_category provenance; consider emitting a provenance row mirroring the food resolver's choice.
